name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Displays code, terminal output and diffs with an optional header, line numbers and a copy button.

files.content:
Default

A title, a copy button and the code. Click copy.

Terminal
$ npm install nepui
added 12 packages in 2s

4 packages are looking for funding
  run `npm fund` for details

Header title as a link

Wrap the title in an anchor to link to a file.

src/greet.js
function greet(name) {
  const message = `Hello, ${name}!`
  console.log(message)
  return message
}

Actions

A wrap toggle next to the copy button.

src/greet.js
const sentence = "A very long line of code that does not fit in the box, so it either scrolls sideways or wraps onto the next line."

Floating actions

No header: the actions show on hover or focus, and always on touch screens. 

function greet(name) {
  const message = `Hello, ${name}!`
  console.log(message)
  return message
}

Line numbers

data-line-numbers on the <pre>.

function greet(name) {
  const message = `Hello, ${name}!`
  console.log(message)
  return message
}

Start line

data-start-line="10".

function greet(name) {
  const message = `Hello, ${name}!`
  console.log(message)
  return message
}

Wrap

data-wrap wraps long lines instead of scrolling.

const sentence = "A very long line of code that does not fit in the box, so it either scrolls sideways or wraps onto the next line."

Highlighted lines

data-highlight="2-3".

function greet(name) {
  const message = `Hello, ${name}!`
  console.log(message)
  return message
}

Diff

data-added and data-removed add a marker, so colour is not the only cue. 

function greet(name) {
  return "Hello"
  return `Hello, ${name}!`
}

Height

--np-code-block-max-height caps the height. The block scrolls and takes focus.

$ npm install nepui
added 12 packages in 2s

4 packages are looking for funding
  run `npm fund` for details

Destructive

np-code-block-destructive for errors.

Error: Cannot find module './config'
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1225:15)
    at require (node:internal/modules/helpers:179:18)

Syntax highlighting

Prism does the highlighting. The colours come from code-block.css.

package.json
{
  "name": "nepui",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": { "build": "tsc" }
}
main.py
import time

def cache(func):
    cache_value = {}
    print(cache_value)

    def wrapper(*args):
        if args in cache_value:
            return cache_value[args]

        result = func(*args)
        cache_value[args] = result
        return result

    return wrapper

@cache
def long_running_func(a, b):
    time.sleep(4)
    return a + b

print(long_running_func(2, 3))
print(long_running_func(2, 3))
print(long_running_func(4, 3))
